bugs.error_message: Bootstrap/Tailwind styling not loading on @vite pages (dashboard, login, etc.); pages render unstyled. Assets requested from http://[::1]:5173/ that never load.
bugs.root_cause: A stale public/hot file was left behind from a previous Vite dev server run (likely crashed or stopped without cleanup). Laravel checks for this file to decide whether to point @vite at the dev server or the built manifest. With the file present but Vite not running, every @vite page referenced missing assets on :5173, so Bootstrap never loaded. The welcome page worked only because it uses an inline <style> block instead of @vite.
bugs.fix: Removed the stale public/hot file. Laravel now falls back to public/build/manifest.json (built assets include Bootstrap 5.3 CSS + JS and Tailwind). To develop with hot reload, run `npm run dev` (it recreates public/hot); when done, stopping Vite cleanly removes it.

bugs.error_message: Render deploy failed at startup with: Database connection [SQLite] not configured.
bugs.root_cause: The app used DB_CONNECTION directly as the Laravel connection name. On Render, the environment value can arrive with different casing, which does not match Laravel's lowercase connection keys.
bugs.fix: Normalized DB_CONNECTION to lowercase in config/database.php and the related database-backed queue config so startup migration and queue metadata resolve the sqlite connection correctly.

bugs.error_message: Render deploy failed again with: Database connection [SQLite] not configured.
bugs.root_cause: The runtime environment still exposed an uppercase DB_CONNECTION value when the container started, so Laravel received the bad connection name before migrations ran.
bugs.fix: Lowercased DB_CONNECTION in the startup script before config caching and migrations, ensuring the app always boots with the sqlite connection name.
